title: Account locked after failed logins
symptoms_raw: user cannot log in, account locked, too many failed login attempts
possibleCause: Lockout policy triggers after 5 failed attempts.
cause: Lockout policy triggers after 5 failed attempts.
prerequisites: Verify user identity per service desk policy.

steps.text: Open admin console > Users and search the user ID.
Click Unlock Account.
Ask the user to reset the password if forgotten.
Confirm the user can log in.

validation: Verify resolution of Account Lockout per runbook.
escalationCondition: Repeated lockouts within 1 hour: escalate to Security team.
escalation: Repeated lockouts within 1 hour: escalate to Security team.

title: Password reset email not received
symptoms_raw: reset link email not arriving, no password reset mail, inbox empty
possibleCause: Mail filter blocking sender or wrong registered address.
cause: Mail filter blocking sender or wrong registered address.

steps.text: Confirm the registered email address.
Check spam and junk folders.
Resend the reset link from the admin console.
Ask the mail admin to allow-list the sender.

validation: Verify resolution of Password Reset per runbook.
escalationCondition: Several users affected: escalate to Messaging team.
escalation: Several users affected: escalate to Messaging team.

title: SSO login loop or expired token
symptoms: redirected back to login page repeatedly
symptoms_raw: redirected back to login page repeatedly, token expired, 401 unauthorized, session timeout
prerequisites: Browser access to the affected user.

steps.text: Clear browser cookies and cache.
Check the device clock is synced.
Sign out of all sessions and sign in again.
Check the identity provider certificate has not expired.

validation: Verify resolution of SSO per runbook.
escalationCondition: More than 10 users affected: escalate to Identity team.
escalation: More than 10 users affected: escalate to Identity team.
keywords: redirected back to login page repeatedly

title: Report page loading very slowly
symptoms_raw: report takes minutes to load, page timeout, high latency, slow screen
possibleCause: Large date range or missing database index.
cause: Large date range or missing database index.

steps.text: Ask the user to narrow the date range.
Check long-running queries in the database monitor.
Rebuild the index on the reporting table.
Clear the application cache and retest.

validation: Verify resolution of Slow Response per runbook.
escalationCondition: Slowness persists over 30 minutes: escalate to DBA team.
escalation: Slowness persists over 30 minutes: escalate to DBA team.

title: High CPU on application server
symptoms_raw: CPU at 95 percent, server unresponsive, thread pool exhausted, high load

steps.text: Identify the top CPU process.
Capture a thread dump.
Check for a deployment in the last 24 hours.
Perform a rolling restart of the service.

validation: Verify resolution of Resource Usage per runbook.
escalationCondition: CPU stays high after restart: escalate to Platform team.
escalation: CPU stays high after restart: escalate to Platform team.

title: Nightly batch job failed
symptoms_raw: batch job failed, scheduler alert, exit code 1, nightly job aborted
possibleCause: Missing input file or failed step.
cause: Missing input file or failed step.

steps.text: Open the scheduler log and find the failing step.
Check the input file exists and is not empty.
Fix the cause of the failure.
Rerun the job from the failed step.

validation: Verify resolution of Job Failure per runbook.
escalationCondition: Second consecutive failure: escalate to Batch support.
escalation: Second consecutive failure: escalate to Batch support.

title: Batch job stuck in running state
symptoms_raw: job running for hours, no progress, stuck, database lock, hung process
possibleCause: Database lock or unfinished dependent job.
cause: Database lock or unfinished dependent job.

steps.text: Check blocking locks in the database.
Verify the upstream job finished.
Stop the hung process as per the runbook.
Rerun the job.

validation: Verify resolution of Job Hang per runbook.
escalationCondition: Job holds a production lock: escalate to DBA team.
escalation: Job holds a production lock: escalate to DBA team.

title: Partner API returns 503 or timeout
symptoms_raw: 503 service unavailable, gateway timeout, connection refused, partner endpoint not responding
possibleCause: Partner endpoint down, expired certificate or firewall rule.
cause: Partner endpoint down, expired certificate or firewall rule.

steps.text: Check the partner endpoint health status.
Verify the TLS certificate validity.
Confirm firewall rules allow the traffic.
Retry with exponential backoff.

validation: Verify resolution of API Timeout per runbook.
escalationCondition: Partner confirms outage: notify the interface owner.
escalation: Partner confirms outage: notify the interface owner.

title: Interface file rejected as malformed
symptoms_raw: SFTP file rejected, schema validation error, invalid delimiter, wrong encoding
possibleCause: File does not match the interface specification.
cause: File does not match the interface specification.

steps.text: Validate the file against the specification.
Check encoding is UTF-8 and the delimiter is correct.
Ask the sender to regenerate the file.
Reprocess the corrected file.

validation: Verify resolution of File Format per runbook.
escalationCondition: Same sender fails 3 times: escalate to Interface owner.
escalation: Same sender fails 3 times: escalate to Interface owner.

title: Duplicate records after data load
symptoms_raw: duplicate rows, repeated customer entries, same record twice after load
possibleCause: Load executed twice or missing unique constraint.
cause: Load executed twice or missing unique constraint.
prerequisites: Database read access and approved cleanup script.

steps.text: Find the load ID that created the duplicates.
Run the duplicate query on the business key.
Remove duplicates using the approved script.
Add a unique key check to the load.

validation: Verify resolution of Duplicates per runbook.
escalationCondition: More than 1000 rows affected: escalate to Data team.
escalation: More than 1000 rows affected: escalate to Data team.

title: Dashboard shows missing data after refresh
symptoms_raw: dashboard empty, totals zero, records missing after refresh, no data shown
possibleCause: ETL load incomplete or stale materialized view.
cause: ETL load incomplete or stale materialized view.

steps.text: Confirm the ETL load completed.
Compare source and target row counts.
Refresh the materialized view.
Reprocess the failed partition.

validation: Verify resolution of Missing Data per runbook.
escalationCondition: Row counts still differ: escalate to Data team.
escalation: Row counts still differ: escalate to Data team.

title: PDF export fails or downloads blank
symptoms_raw: export button error, PDF blank, download fails, report export not generated
possibleCause: Low temp disk space or stuck export queue.
cause: Low temp disk space or stuck export queue.

steps.text: Check free disk space on the temp volume.
Clear the export queue.
Retry with a smaller data range.
Confirm the PDF opens correctly.

validation: Verify resolution of Export Failure per runbook.
escalationCondition: Disk cannot be freed: escalate to Platform team.
escalation: Disk cannot be freed: escalate to Platform team.
